test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some roads are fans.

No fan is a car.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some roads are cars.

(II) Some fans are roads.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b3ba7b202e6ced5938073bbcf17454670b514f97f6a7315b5d37ed80fb7588f0.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40a576dc37962ce7f160489c9e5ffcdea0346591f17e0fadf0b530de3875d9ba.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some roads are cars → **Does not **follow (As some roads are fans and no fan is a car. So it is possible but not definite.)

II. Some fans are roads → Follow (As some roads are fans. As some part of roads is common with fans, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion (II) follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
